tools.name: uservoice_get_account
tools.description: The UserVoice account (subdomain) these credentials belong to: id, name, default forum and settings. GET /api/v2/admin/subdomains/current.

tools.name: uservoice_list_forums
tools.description: List the feedback forums (idea portals) with name, open/private state and suggestion counts. Use a forum id to filter or create suggestions. GET /api/v2/admin/forums.

tools.name: uservoice_list_categories
tools.description: List suggestion categories, optionally only those of some forums. GET /api/v2/admin/categories.

tools.name: uservoice_list_statuses
tools.description: List the public suggestion statuses (e.g. under review, planned, started, completed, declined) with ids, colors and open/closed flag. Use the ids for filters and status updates. GET /api/v2/admin/statuses.

tools.name: uservoice_list_labels
tools.description: List or search the labels used to organize suggestions. GET /api/v2/admin/labels.

tools.name: uservoice_list_suggestions
tools.description: List or search suggestions (ideas) with title, body, state, vote/supporter counts, revenue of supporters and links to forum, category, status and labels. Filter by text, forum, category, status, state, label or created/updated time. GET /api/v2/admin/suggestions.

tools.name: uservoice_get_suggestion
tools.description: One suggestion (idea) by id, optionally with related records (forum, category, status, labels, users, status updates). GET /api/v2/admin/suggestions/{id}.

tools.name: uservoice_list_comments
tools.description: List public comments, optionally only those on some suggestions or in some moderation states. GET /api/v2/admin/comments.

tools.name: uservoice_list_notes
tools.description: List internal (admin-only) notes, optionally only those on one suggestion. GET /api/v2/admin/notes.

tools.name: uservoice_list_status_updates
tools.description: List the public status updates posted on suggestions (message, how many supporters were emailed, opens/clicks, reactions). GET /api/v2/admin/status_updates.

tools.name: uservoice_list_supporters
tools.description: List supporters (voters) of suggestions: who supports what, how (channel), importance and subscription. Filter by suggestion, user or forum. GET /api/v2/admin/supporters.

tools.name: uservoice_list_feedback_records
tools.description: List captured feedback (from the admin console, widget, Zendesk, Salesforce, Slack, API ...), optionally only that linked to some suggestions or users. GET /api/v2/admin/feedback_records.

tools.name: uservoice_list_features
tools.description: List product features (the roadmap items suggestions are linked to) with suggestion counts and supporter revenue. Filter by text, linked suggestion or product area. GET /api/v2/admin/features.

tools.name: uservoice_list_users
tools.description: List or search end users and admins (name, email, satisfaction score, supported suggestions count). Filter by text, email address or supported suggestion. GET /api/v2/admin/users.

tools.name: uservoice_get_user
tools.description: One user by id. GET /api/v2/admin/users/{id}.

tools.name: uservoice_create_suggestion
tools.description: WRITE: create a new suggestion (idea) in a forum, optionally in a category and on behalf of a user (by email; the user is created if new). It appears on the portal. POST /api/v2/admin/suggestions.

tools.name: uservoice_add_comment
tools.description: WRITE: post a PUBLIC comment on a suggestion, visible on the portal and emailed to its subscribers, optionally on behalf of a user (by email). For an admin-only remark use uservoice_add_note. POST /api/v2/admin/comments.

tools.name: uservoice_add_note
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal note (admins only, never shown to end users) to a suggestion, optionally as a reply to another note. POST /api/v2/admin/notes.

tools.name: uservoice_post_status_update
tools.description: WRITE: post a public status update on a suggestion, optionally changing its public status (see uservoice_list_statuses). Supporters are emailed ONLY when notify_supporters is true. POST /api/v2/admin/status_updates.

tools.name: uservoice_add_feedback
tools.description: WRITE: capture a piece of customer feedback (for example from a call or ticket), optionally from a user (by email) and linked to a suggestion, which adds that user's support. POST /api/v2/admin/feedback_records.

tools.name: uservoice_attach_label
tools.description: WRITE: attach a label to a suggestion (attaching it again changes nothing). POST /api/v2/admin/labels/attach.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "uservoice_get_account" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: The UserVoice account (subdomain) these credentials belong to: id, name, default forum and settings. GET /api/v2/admin/subdomains/current.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: uservoice_list_statuses, uservoice_list_comments, uservoice_list_status_updates, uservoice_list_users · Private data: uservoice_get_account, uservoice_list_forums, uservoice_get_suggestion, uservoice_list_feedback_records · Public sink: uservoice_list_users, uservoice_create_suggestion, uservoice_add_comment, uservoice_add_note, uservoice_post_status_update, uservoice_add_feedback, uservoice_attach_label.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: uservoice_list_statuses, uservoice_list_comments, uservoice_list_status_updates, uservoice_list_users · Private data: uservoice_get_account, uservoice_list_forums, uservoice_get_suggestion, uservoice_list_feedback_records · Public sink: uservoice_list_users, uservoice_create_suggestion, uservoice_add_comment, uservoice_add_note, uservoice_post_status_update, uservoice_add_feedback, uservoice_attach_label

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
